name.full: NIRAS App Migration for Copilot Code

description.short: Recreate Lovable, HTML and other apps in Copilot Code with SharePoint storage.
description.full: Recreate vibe-coded solutions as new Copilot Code apps. Explore available source and workflows, recover business rules, ask focused questions when intent is unclear, build a fresh native managed app, guide SharePoint persistence, verify behavior and publish when migration is requested. Includes Lovable and static HTML playbooks, platform capability guidance, evidence templates and a read-only source inventory utility. Uses the host coding and approved data tools; this skills-only package does not itself provide source access, data connections or deployment credentials. Publisher: NIRAS A/S.
